name: Fiery Ice Storm
body:
School evocation [cold, fire]; Level druid 6, magus 6, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Target 20-ft.-radius cylinder, 40 ft. high

Duration instantaneous, see text

Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

You call a terrifying storm of flaming meteors and chunks of freezing ice. All creatures in the area or who enter it take 6d6 fire damage and 6d6 cold damage. The area also is filled with steam and functions as a fog cloud for 1 minute thereafter.
